status: FROZEN for KUN-01-SWISS-01 (predeclared before the first real run; changing any value needs a written reason and QA review)
claim_boundary: Swiss-on-Swiss integration conformance: Sabpuja's Python integration agrees with the tested Swiss Ephemeris CLI for these cases, versions and options. NOT independent astronomical validation; not related to tests/golden independent-reference classes or tolerances.

meaning.-edir: same verified directory as the engine (sepl_18.se1, semo_18.se1)
meaning.-bj: Julian Day (UT) printed with repr() so the double round-trips exactly
meaning.-ut: input is UT; the engine also treats civil UTC as UT1 (SCI-01h pending)
meaning.-sid1: SE_SIDM_LAHIRI (mode 1), t0 and ayan_t0 0, as swe.set_sid_mode(SIDM_LAHIRI, 0, 0)
meaning.-i65538: iflag SEFLG_SWIEPH(2) | SEFLG_SIDEREAL(65536), the engine's calc_ut flags; swetest applies -i only with its header enabled, so the header is kept
meaning.-i65536: iflag SEFLG_SIDEREAL only, the engine's houses_ex flags
meaning.-p0123456m: Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, mean node
meaning.-p: empty planet list for the houses run
meaning.-house<LON>,<LAT>,P: Placidus houses at the case location; Ascendant is ascmc[0], the engine's Lagna vehicle
meaning.-fPl -ep -g,: name and decimal longitude with 11 decimals, comma separated

binding_vs_swetest.basis: same C source; swetest prints 11 decimals (half unit 5e-12 deg); allowance for compiler/optimisation differences between the -O0 swetest build and the pyswisseph wheel

engine_vs_swetest.basis: engine displays 8 decimals (half unit 5e-9 deg) plus binding_vs_swetest

swetest_ut_jd_day.basis: swetest prints UT JD with 9 decimals (half unit 5e-10 day)

independent_jd_day.basis: double JD near 2.45e6 has a spacing of 4.66e-10 day

ketu_identity_deg.basis: two 8-decimal displays of an exact identity

boundary_rule: A category check whose swetest longitude lies within binding_vs_swetest of a Pada edge (all Rashi, Nakshatra and D9 edges are Pada edges) is BOUNDARY-INDETERMINATE unless the binding's unrounded value and the swetest value fall in the same segment, in which case it is resolved and compared.
verdict_rule: Any FAIL makes the run SWISS-CONFORMANCE FAIL. Otherwise any BLOCKED or BOUNDARY-INDETERMINATE check, any failed provenance or input-validation gate, or a run that does not deliver the frozen coverage (the 24 predeclared cases, 49 named checks for each of the 18 chart cases = 882, and 2 self-consistency checks per chart case) makes it SWISS-CONFORMANCE BLOCKED. Only a run in which every check passes is SWISS-CONFORMANCE PASS.
